passage.en: Every morning I walk into my bright classroom and get ready for another lesson. Our teacher takes attendance first, and then we open our notebooks. Today's assignment is short, but the homework due on Friday is much longer. During the quiz, I must be careful with every answer to get a good grade. When the bell rings for recess, my friends and I talk and laugh together. School life is busy, but I enjoy learning new things every day.
passage.zh: 每天早晨，我走进明亮的教室，准备开始又一节课。老师先点名，然后我们打开笔记本。今天的作业不多，但周五要交的家庭作业要长得多。小测验时，我必须仔细作答每一题，才能拿到好成绩。课间铃响时，我和朋友们一起说笑。学校生活很忙碌，但我喜欢每天学习新东西。

passage.en: Last week we had a difficult exam. There were twenty questions, and I was not sure about the last one. I tried to answer every question carefully. After the test, our teacher did not explain the answers in class; instead, she gave us an example on the board. When the result came out, I was happy to see my score. I did not fail — I passed! My teacher said my correct answers showed real progress.
passage.zh: 上周我们进行了一次很难的考试。有二十道题，最后一道我不太确定。我努力仔细回答每一题。考完后，老师没有在课堂上讲解答案，而是在黑板上举了一个例子。结果出来时，我高兴地看到自己的分数。我没有不及格——我通过了！老师说我的正确答案显示了真正的进步。

passage.en: For our history project, I went to the library to do some research. I needed to borrow two books and use an old map as a reference. I took notes carefully, made an outline, and then wrote a short report with a summary at the end. Before I returned the books, I spent one more hour to review everything. Finishing the project on time made me feel proud.
passage.zh: 为了历史项目，我去图书馆做一些研究。我需要借两本书，并用一张旧地图作为参考。我认真记笔记，列了提纲，然后写了一份简短的报告，结尾附上摘要。在还书之前，我又花了一小时复习所有内容。按时完成项目让我感到自豪。

passage.en: This semester, our campus is full of energy. My schedule is busy: I have classes in the morning and club activities in the afternoon. I joined the music club, where we practice every Tuesday and rehearse for a big event next month. Our coach says our team must work together to win the tournament. Even when practice is hard, I enjoy being part of it.
passage.zh: 这学期，我们的校园充满活力。我的日程很忙：上午上课，下午参加社团活动。我加入了音乐社团，每周二练习，并为下个月的大型活动排练。我们的教练说，团队必须齐心协力才能赢得比赛。即使练习很辛苦，我也乐在其中。

passage.en: My daily routine starts with a quick breakfast at seven. I follow a simple schedule: after breakfast, I do a small chore like washing dishes. On weekends I also do the laundry and run an errand to the market for groceries. My mother uses a recipe with fresh ingredients to prepare our evening meal. Even a busy day feels calm when everything is in order.
passage.zh: 我的日常作息从七点的简单早餐开始。我遵循一个简单的日程：早餐后做点家务，比如洗碗。周末我还会洗衣服，跑腿去市场买食品杂货。妈妈用一份食谱和新鲜食材准备晚餐。一切井井有条时，再忙的一天也让人安心。

passage.en: Yesterday I commuted to the city centre for a meeting. As a passenger on the train, I checked the direction and chose the fastest route. There was heavy traffic near the bridge, so my vehicle moved slowly. I bought my ticket early and waited on the platform. Thanks to clear signs, I reached my destination on time.
passage.zh: 昨天我通勤去市中心开会。作为火车上的一名乘客，我确认了方向并选择了最快的路线。桥附近交通拥堵，所以我的车开得很慢。我提前买了票，在站台上等候。多亏了清晰的指示牌，我准时到达了目的地。

passage.en: As a careful customer, I always set a budget before shopping. Last Saturday I wanted to buy a new jacket. I compared the price in three shops and found one on sale with a discount. The quality was good, so I decided to purchase it. I kept the receipt in case I needed a refund. Smart shopping is not just about saving money.
passage.zh: 作为细心的顾客，我购物前总会定好预算。上周六我想买一件新夹克。我比较了三家店的价格，发现一件正在打折促销。质量不错，所以我决定买下它。我保留了收据，以防需要退款。聪明购物不只是省钱。

passage.en: I made an appointment at the clinic by phone. The receptionist checked what time was available and helped me confirm the reservation. I had to request a morning slot because of my class. Two days later, the clinic called to notify me of a short delay. I could not wait, so I had to cancel and postpone it to next week. Good service means clear communication.
passage.zh: 我打电话预约了诊所。接待员查了可预约的时间，帮我确认了预约。因为上课，我只能要求上午的时段。两天后，诊所打电话通知我时间会稍有延迟。我等不了，只好取消并推迟到下周。好的服务意味着清晰的沟通。

passage.en: In our group project, we first analyze the data and then arrange our tasks. We communicate by email and compare our ideas before we complete the report. My teacher asks us to consider every detail, describe the results, and identify any problems we discover. In this way, we improve our work step by step.
passage.zh: 在小组项目中，我们先分析数据，然后安排任务。我们通过邮件交流，在完成报告前比较各自的想法。老师要求我们考虑每个细节、描述结果，并指出发现的问题。这样，我们一步步改进自己的工作。

passage.en: In science class we observe the plants and predict how they will grow. We prepare the soil and provide enough water. To solve the problem of slow growth, we must require more light. After one week we recognize a clear change. We summarize our notes and participate in a discussion. At last, we achieve a result that surprises everyone.
passage.zh: 在科学课上，我们观察植物并预测它们的生长。我们准备土壤，提供充足的水。为了解决生长缓慢的问题，我们必须要求更多光照。一周后，我们认出了明显的变化。我们总结笔记并参与讨论。最后，我们取得了让所有人惊讶的成果。

passage.en: All the reference books are available in the library, and a good report must be accurate. The basic facts should be easy to find. Some questions are complex, but a clear outline is effective. Hard work is essential if you want a positive result. It is obvious that frequent practice helps, because constant effort leads to improvement. Always check your work carefully.
passage.zh: 所有参考书在图书馆都能找到，一份好的报告必须准确，基本事实应该易于查找。有些问题很复杂，但清晰的提纲很有效。想要积极的结果，努力是必不可少的。显而易见，经常练习有帮助，因为持续的努力会带来进步。务必仔细检查你的作业。

passage.en: We visited an ancient temple built in a traditional style. The carvings were original and showed diverse influences from many cultures. Our guide explained the immediate reason for each feature and the potential meaning behind it. In a global context, such sites are critical evidence of history. Look at the specific details and you will see the natural beauty.
passage.zh: 我们参观了一座传统风格的古庙。雕刻独具匠心，展现了来自多种文化的多样影响。导游解释了每处特征的直接成因及其背后的潜在含义。在全球背景下，这类遗迹是历史的关键证据。仔细观察具体细节，你就会看到自然之美。

passage.en: I currently live in a small town, but I frequently visit the city. I usually plan carefully before a trip and check the map clearly. The bus arrives approximately every ten minutes and is constantly on time. I can directly reach the museum. Actually, the trip takes longer than I thought. Eventually, I learned to leave early, and now I completely enjoy the journey.
passage.zh: 我目前住在一个小镇，但经常去城里。出行前我通常会仔细计划，把地图看清楚。公交车大约每十分钟一班，而且总是准时。我可以直接坐公交到博物馆。其实，路程比我想的要长。最终，我学会了早点出发，现在我完全享受这段旅程。

passage.en: I typically get up at six, and generally I have breakfast with my family. Originally, I thought the walk to school was boring, but now I see it differently. Occasionally I meet a neighbor, and we talk naturally. Particularly in winter, the morning is quiet. Previously I was always in a hurry; now I leave regularly with enough time. Yesterday, suddenly, it began to snow, and I immediately ran to the window.
passage.zh: 我通常六点起床，一般和家人一起吃早餐。起初我觉得走路上学很无聊，但现在看法不同了。偶尔我会遇到邻居，我们自然交谈。尤其在冬天，早晨很安静。以前我总是匆匆忙忙；现在我有规律地留出充足时间。昨天，突然下起了雪，我立刻跑到窗边。

passage.en: Many students fear writing; however, it becomes easier with practice. Therefore, we should write a little every day. Moreover, reading good essays helps a lot. Although it takes time, the results are clear because words slowly become familiar. Unless you give up, you will improve. Meanwhile, keep a small notebook. In addition, ask a friend to read your work. For example, you can exchange stories. As a result, writing feels less difficult.
passage.zh: 许多学生害怕写作，然而，多练习就会变简单。因此，我们应该每天写一点。此外，读好文章大有帮助。虽然这需要时间，但效果明显，因为词汇会慢慢变熟悉。除非你放弃，否则一定会进步。与此同时，随身带个小笔记本。另外，请朋友读你的作品。例如，你们可以交换故事。结果，写作就没那么难了。

passage.en: At first I was curious about the new club. I felt confident on the first day, but soon became anxious before the test. When I got the highest score, I was excited. My friend was frustrated because he made mistakes, yet he was determined to try again. Our teacher was impressed with our progress but skeptical of easy answers. Some students were puzzled, while others were enthusiastic about the next challenge.
passage.zh: 起初我对新社团很好奇。第一天我很自信，但考试前很快变得焦虑。当我拿到最高分时，我很兴奋。我的朋友因为犯错而沮丧，但他决心再试一次。老师对我们的进步印象深刻，但对轻而易举的答案持怀疑态度。有些学生困惑不解，另一些则对下一个挑战充满热情。

passage.en: My ancestor came from a small village, and now our whole generation lives in a big city. As a citizen, I care about the population growth and the future of our society. In my community, every neighbor knows each other. We keep a custom of sharing meals and a tradition of helping newcomers. Last year I worked as a volunteer to clean the park. Small actions can shape a better society.
passage.zh: 我的祖先来自一个小村庄，现在我们这一代住在大城市。作为公民，我关心人口增长和社会的未来。在我的社区里，每个邻居都互相认识。我们保留着一起用餐的风俗和帮助新人的传统。去年我做志愿者清理公园。小小的行动能塑造更好的社会。

passage.en: Everyone has the ability to learn, but the approach matters. One important aspect of study is finding your purpose. The main benefit is clear: you understand the concept better. Another key factor is time. If the situation changes, a flexible resource plan helps. People have a tendency to give up too early, so keep your goal in mind and try a different way.
passage.zh: 每个人都有学习的能力，但方法很重要。学习的一个重要方面是找到你的目标。主要好处很明显：你能更好地理解概念。另一个关键因素是时间。如果情况发生变化，灵活的资源计划会有帮助。人们往往太早放弃，所以牢记目标，换个方式试试。

passage.en: Every organism belongs to a species and lives in a habitat. In a healthy ecosystem, a predator hunts its prey, and weak animals must adapt to survive. Some birds migrate south in winter, while bears hibernate until spring. Over many years, species evolve to fit their environment. These changes show how life on Earth continues.
passage.zh: 每个生物都属于一个物种，生活在栖息地中。在健康的生态系统里，捕食者猎食猎物，弱小的动物必须适应才能生存。有些鸟冬天南迁，而熊则冬眠到春天。许多年来，物种不断进化以适应环境。这些变化展示了地球上的生命如何延续。

passage.en: Plants use photosynthesis to make food, and pollination helps them produce seeds. Inside every living cell, genes carry information that children inherit from parents. Good immunity can fight a virus or bacteria. When a person has a symptom, a doctor may give a vaccine to prevent disease. Science helps us understand how the body works.
passage.zh: 植物通过光合作用制造养分，授粉帮助它们结籽。在每个活细胞内，基因携带子女从父母那里继承的信息。良好的免疫力可以对抗病毒或细菌。当人出现症状时，医生可能会接种疫苗来预防疾病。科学帮助我们理解身体如何运作。

passage.en: Good nutrition supports metabolism, which turns food into energy. Biodiversity is important because every species has a role. Some animals use camouflage to hide from a predator, while a parasite lives on another organism. Domestic plants grow well in fertile soil. Scientists study a specimen under a microscope to understand how living things reproduce.
passage.zh: 良好的营养支持新陈代谢，将食物转化为能量。生物多样性很重要，因为每个物种都有其作用。有些动物用伪装躲避捕食者，而寄生虫则生活在另一生物体上。驯化的植物在肥沃的土壤里长得好。科学家在显微镜下研究标本，以了解生物如何繁殖。

passage.en: Rain causes erosion, carrying sediment down the river. A glacier moves slowly and shapes the land. When a volcano erupts, hot rock and ash fly into the air. An earthquake or a landslide can change a region in minutes. Each continent has its own tectonic plates, and their movement over centuries leaves a fossil or a rich mineral deposit.
passage.zh: 雨水造成侵蚀，把沉积物带下河流。冰川缓慢移动，塑造地形。火山喷发时，灼热的岩石和火山灰冲向空中。地震或山体滑坡能在几分钟内改变一个地区。每个大陆都有自己的板块，它们几个世纪的运动留下化石或丰富的矿藏。

passage.en: A fossil tells us about the climate of the past. Today, we must protect renewable energy and save water during a drought. Heavy rainfall can cause a flood, especially near the ocean. The tide changes twice a day, and latitude and altitude affect temperature. Understanding these patterns helps us prepare for natural changes.
passage.zh: 化石告诉我们过去的气候。今天，我们必须保护可再生能源，并在干旱时节约用水。强降雨可能引发洪水，尤其在海洋附近。潮汐一天变化两次，纬度和海拔影响温度。理解这些规律有助于我们应对自然变化。

passage.en: Earth is one planet that travels around the sun in an orbit. Gravity keeps the planets in place. During an eclipse, the moon blocks the sunlight. With a telescope, we can see a distant galaxy, a bright comet, or a shooting meteor. Somewhere in the universe, a cloud of gas called a nebula forms new stars. Space is full of wonder.
passage.zh: 地球是沿轨道绕太阳运行的行星之一。引力使行星各就各位。日食时，月球挡住阳光。用望远镜，我们能看到遥远的星系、明亮的彗星或划过的流星。在宇宙某处，称为星云的气体云形成新恒星。太空充满奇迹。

passage.en: Light is a wave, and its wavelength decides its color. Some radiation, such as X-rays, has a high frequency and carries more energy. Kinetic energy depends on motion, while friction slows things down. In a vacuum, sound cannot travel. A conductor lets electricity pass, but an insulator blocks it. A magnet can pull metal from a distance.
passage.zh: 光是一种波，其波长决定颜色。某些辐射（如X射线）频率高、携带更多能量。动能取决于运动，而摩擦使物体减速。在真空中，声音无法传播。导体让电流通过，绝缘体则阻挡电流。磁铁能隔空吸引金属。

passage.en: Water is a compound made of hydrogen and oxygen. Each element consists of tiny atoms, and two or more atoms form a molecule. In a chemical reaction, an acid can dissolve metal. When water gets hot, it evaporates; when vapor cools, it condenses. Over time, iron can corrode. Chemistry explains these changes all around us.
passage.zh: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。每种元素由微小的原子构成，两个或更多原子形成分子。在化学反应中，酸可以溶解金属。水受热会蒸发，蒸汽冷却会凝结。随着时间推移，铁会腐蚀。化学解释了我们周围的这些变化。

passage.en: An alloy is stronger than a single metal, and fiber is used to make cloth. A ceramic cup can hold hot water without melting. However, some materials are toxic and can pollute the air. Smoke enters the atmosphere and makes the greenhouse effect worse. We should recycle waste so it does not contaminate soil. Everyone wants a sustainable future.
passage.zh: 合金比单一金属更坚固，纤维被用来做布料。陶瓷杯可以盛热水而不融化。然而，有些材料有毒，会污染空气。烟雾进入大气，加剧温室效应。我们应该回收废物，以免污染土壤。每个人都想要可持续的未来。

passage.en: A great civilization often begins near a river. In ancient times, one dynasty replaced another, and a powerful empire ruled a large area. Archaeologists study a buried artifact or an old manuscript to learn about the past. A century later, a revolution can change everything. Migration of people also brings new ideas and shapes history.
passage.zh: 伟大的文明常起源于河边。古代，一个朝代取代另一个，强大的帝国统治着广阔地区。考古学家研究埋藏的文物或古老手稿来了解过去。一个世纪之后，一场革命可能改变一切。人口迁移也带来新思想，塑造历史。

passage.en: A strong economy depends on agriculture, industry, and commerce. When people work together, labor becomes more productive. Democracy gives citizens a voice in government. Philosophy asks big questions about life, while religion answers them in a different way. A traditional ritual can bring a community together. In every society, culture shapes the way people live.
passage.zh: 强大的经济依赖农业、工业和商业。人们一起工作时，劳动力效率更高。民主让公民在政府中有发言权。哲学追问人生的大问题，宗教则以不同方式作答。传统仪式能把社区凝聚起来。在每个社会里，文化塑造人们的生活方式。

passage.en: The artist painted a portrait of an old man on a canvas. She mixed bright pigment to show realistic light. In another room, an abstract sculpture stood near the window. Their exhibition opened in a small gallery last week. The architecture of the building was beautiful, and visitors admired its aesthetic value. Art can express what words cannot.
passage.zh: 艺术家在画布上画了一幅老人的肖像。她调出明亮的颜料来表现真实的光线。在另一个房间，一座抽象雕塑立在窗边。他们的展览上周在一家小画廊开幕。建筑本身的架构很美，参观者赞叹其审美价值。艺术能表达语言无法表达的东西。

passage.en: The composer wrote a melody with a gentle rhythm and added harmony for the strings. Each instrument had its own part in the performance. When the concert began, the audience listened quietly. Later, I read a poem from a book of literature. Poetry uses beautiful words, just as music uses sound. Every genre has its own charm.
passage.zh: 作曲家写下一段旋律，配上柔和的节奏，并为弦乐加入和声。每种乐器在演出中都有自己的声部。音乐会开始时，观众安静聆听。后来，我读了一本文学集里的一首诗。诗歌使用优美的文字，正如音乐使用声音。每种体裁都有其独特的魅力。

passage.en: To solve the problem, first calculate the total and then estimate the answer. The ratio of boys to girls is two to three. If fifty percent of students passed, that means half the class. We can find the average by adding the numbers. Statistics help us read data, while probability tells us what may happen. In geometry, we measure angles and find the quantity of each side.
passage.zh: 解题时，先计算总数，再估算答案。男生与女生的比例是二比三。如果百分之五十的学生通过，意味着全班一半的人。把数字相加就能求出平均值。统计帮助我们读懂数据，概率告诉我们可能发生什么。在几何中，我们测量角度并求出每条边的数量。

passage.en: We can approximate the answer before we calculate it exactly. In math class, we contrast two graphs and study the proportion of each part. A sequence follows a pattern, and a variable can stand for any number. The sum is the result of adding, while the difference comes from subtracting. One number may be a multiple of another, and two fractions can be equivalent. The gap between them is called an interval.
passage.zh: 在精确计算之前，我们可以先估算答案。数学课上，我们对比两张图，研究每一部分的比例。数列遵循某种规律，变量可以代表任何数字。和是相加的结果，差来自相减。一个数可能是另一个数的倍数，两个分数可能相等。它们之间的间隔称为区间。

passage.en: A scientist starts with a hypothesis and builds a theory around it. To collect evidence, she may run a survey or an experiment. She will observe the results carefully and demonstrate them in a chart. Her analysis must indicate whether the idea is correct. In the end, she writes a clear conclusion so others can understand the work.
passage.zh: 科学家从假设开始，围绕它建立理论。为收集证据，她可能做调查或实验。她会仔细观察结果，并用图表展示。她的分析必须表明这个想法是否正确。最后，她写出清晰的结论，让别人能理解这项工作。

passage.en: In an essay, you should suggest ideas and imply meaning without saying everything. First, define your key words, then classify your examples. A good writer can illustrate a point with a story and summarize the main idea. Before you evaluate the evidence, do not assume it is true. Try to establish a clear argument, even if others may contradict you.
passage.zh: 在文章里，你应该提出观点、暗示含义，而不必和盘托出。先定义关键词，再对例子分类。好的作者能用故事说明观点，并总结主旨。在评估证据之前，不要假定它是真的。即使别人可能反驳你，也要努力建立清晰的论证。

passage.en: The primary reason for the change is clear. A significant number of students joined the club, particularly in the second term. The task was relatively easy, and virtually everyone finished it. It was merely a small test, rather than a real exam. Hence, nobody felt stressed. Thus, the teacher was pleased. Whereas some classes were noisy, ours stayed quiet.
passage.zh: 这一变化的主要原因很明显。相当多的学生加入了社团，尤其是在第二学期。任务相对容易，几乎每个人都完成了。这只是一个小测验，而不是真正的考试。因此，没人感到紧张。于是，老师很满意。有些班级很吵，而我们班保持安静。

passage.en: Human behavior is shaped by both instinct and learning. Our cognitive skills help us perceive the world and solve problems. A reward can motivate a student, and praise may reinforce good behavior. However, money is not the only incentive. Personality also matters: a shy child may think deeply, while a bright one shows high intelligence. Understanding the mind is a fascinating field.
passage.zh: 人类的行为由本能和学习共同塑造。我们的认知能力帮助我们感知世界、解决问题。奖励能激励学生，表扬可能强化良好行为。然而，金钱不是唯一的动机。性格也很重要：害羞的孩子可能思考深入，聪明的孩子则表现出很高的智力。理解心灵是一个迷人的领域。

passage.en: A company's productivity rises when workers have better tools. If supply is low but demand is high, prices go up. When inflation grows, money buys less than before. A business must earn a profit to survive. A bonus can be a strong incentive to work harder. Many people invest in the market to grow their savings. Smart consumption depends on available resources and careful choices.
passage.zh: 工人有更好的工具时，公司的生产力会提高。如果供给低而需求高，价格就会上涨。通胀上升时，货币的购买力下降。企业必须盈利才能生存。奖金可能是努力工作的强大激励。许多人在市场投资以增加储蓄。理性消费取决于可用资源和谨慎选择。

passage.en: A smart device is made of many parts. Inside it, a small mechanism controls each component. Engineers integrate these pieces and modify the design to make it efficient. Some factories use automated machines to work faster. Before mass production, they build a prototype and test it. Then they optimize the system step by step. To innovate, a team must be willing to try new ideas and learn from failure.
passage.zh: 智能设备由许多部件组成。其中，一个小机制控制着每个组件。工程师整合这些部件，并修改设计使其高效。一些工厂使用自动化机器来加快工作。在大规模生产之前，他们制造原型进行测试。然后逐步优化系统。要创新，团队必须愿意尝试新想法并从失败中学习。

passage.en: Good writing demonstrates clear thinking. Consequently, readers understand your message. Furthermore, short sentences can make a strong point. Nevertheless, do not fear long ones when you need detail. Approximately eight out of ten students improve after practice. A significant change may take time, but the fundamental skill stays the same. Additional reading helps, and subsequently, an alternative method is to write every day.
passage.zh: 好的写作展现清晰的思维。因此，读者能理解你的信息。此外，短句能表达有力的观点。尽管如此，需要细节时不要害怕长句。大约十分之八的学生在练习后会进步。显著的改变可能需要时间，但基本技能不变。额外阅读有帮助，随后，另一种方法是每天写作。
